title: Falling Down: Gravity
goal: Gravity pulls the hero down unless something holds them.
mascot_lines: Gravity is the rule that pulls things down, frame after frame.
Without it, our hero would just float forever like a balloon.
We add a tiny number to the hero's vertical speed every frame, so they fall faster and faster.
When they land on the ground, gravity stops — until they jump again.

tier2.rephrase: Order the steps when a hero walks off a platform edge.

tier3.nudge: First the floor ends. Then gravity kicks in. Then the hero falls. Then they land!
